name: The Class of One
format: Interactive online sessions; live or recorded not stated; group size not stated (described as small batches)
timings: Indian track: Grades 1-2 about 3 hours a day, Grades 3-5 about 3.5 hours a day; 5 days a week
timings_note: Two batches a day by grade. UK track: Grades 1-2 1:00-4:00 PM, Grades 3-5 1:00-4:30 PM. Pages do not agree on exact hours.

curriculum.summary: The Indian track follows NEP 2020 and NCF 2023 (CBSE and NIOS). The UK track uses the iPrimary programme. Art, music, dance and fitness are offered as co-curricular classes.
